newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates mixed in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates mixed in quiet market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound on Monday slipped to between 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent in a quiet private sector market, compared with a range of 7-3/4 and 9-1/2 percent on Sunday, bankers said.
Several bankers said they did not make any one-week deals but some put the rates at between 8 and 9-1/2 percent. Sunday's rates were narrower at 8 and 8-3/4 percent.
Bankers said public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
